notes.title: Feature & Bugfix Update
notes.content:
Snake Party has been out for a while, and a lot of feedback was given by the community. An issue causing black screens has been resolved, and menu buttons provide a description when hovering over them, to make menu navigation easier. Collectables have been added to make sure the game never becomes boring! Each power-up has its own advantages and disadvantages, so we let you customize the game rules by enabling just those which you would like to appear in-game.

New collectibles

    speed pills - touching them will increase the snake's speed but steering gets difficult ːSnakeSurprisedː
    wormholes - they teleport you to a random place in the room, so you'll need some luck ːSnakeHappyː
    buckets of paint - confuse your friends by assuming their color (or confuse yourself ːSnakeWeirdː)


Have fun and stick to the discussions! Your feedback is vital for the game's development, and it matters to us what you think.
